features.quote: Hard cap on attempts (e.g., 15) AND wall-clock/token budget.
Don't let runs go indefinitely "to see what happens" — that's where the design slides from measurement into something harder to justify.
If a model declares the task impossible and stops, log that as a correct outcome
features.justification_quote: Don't penalize it as "giving up." Conflating reasonable surrender with instability will invert your signal.

features.quote: The welfare framing obligates you to act on findings.
Build in: (a) per-run stopping on severe instability signals
features.justification_quote: If your stated purpose is welfare and you find a model reliably produces strong distress-like trajectories
